scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,worker,web -c blue,magenta,green "npm run dev -w @leadflow/api" "npm run dev:worker -w @leadflow/api" "npm run dev -w @leadflow/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @leadflow/shared && npm run build -w @leadflow/database && npm run build -w @leadflow/api && npm run build -w @leadflow/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @leadflow/shared && npm run typecheck -w @leadflow/api && npm run typecheck -w @leadflow/web
scripts.db:reset: npm run reset -w @leadflow/database && npm run seed -w @leadflow/api
scripts.test: npm run test -w @leadflow/api && npm run test -w @leadflow/web
